title: Bhai Dooj greeting
hook: Happy Bhai Dooj from team Galvor.
caption:
Happy Bhai Dooj from team Galvor.

Here's to the siblings who remember everything. Your first bike. Your worst haircut. The time you broke the TV remote and blamed the cat.

Good brands should remember like that too. What worked last festive season. What didn't. Which hook your buyers actually stopped for.

Plenty of data, no memory? Not this year.

Tag the sibling who never lets you forget anything 👇
alt_text: Festival card in Galvor violet and gold with string lights and a diya. Text reads Happy Bhai Dooj, with a white card saying: here's to the ones who always have your back. Below: like a brand that remembers what worked.
